hero.html:
Level 5 - Interview-ready 45 min Deep dive Strings

String matching: KMP, Z-function, rolling hash

Three linear-time tools for "find this pattern", "the longest prefix that is also a suffix" and "how many different substrings". The prefix function (the heart of KMP), the Z-function and the rolling hash (Rabin-Karp) all reuse work that a naive search throws away. This page builds each one step by step, solves shortest palindrome, repeated string match and distinct substrings with them, and covers what an SDE-3 is asked about collisions, streams and choosing between them. Templates in Go, C++, Java and Python.
